_comment: These are OUTREACH TARGETS only — not scholarships. Seed patterns for metros; humans research local chapters and contact them. No scraping.

org_types.why_target: Many posts and auxiliaries fund small local awards with low applicant pools.
Local posts often run oratorical / school awards separate from national programs.
org_types.suggested_search_terms: American Legion scholarship [city], Legion auxiliary [county] scholarship

org_types.why_target: Nearly every metro has clubs that fund high-school or college awards.
Strong local service awards; often county/high-school based.
Lodge-level and state Elks awards; local residency often required.
Often administer dozens of donor funds for one region — high yield per partnership.

org_types.org_type: County Bar Association / Law Firm Foundation
org_types.why_target: Niche legal-interest or local-HS awards; under-listed nationally.
org_types.suggested_search_terms: [county] bar association scholarship, [city] law firm scholarship foundation

org_types.why_target: Nursing and allied-health local awards with real contacts.
org_types.suggested_search_terms: [hospital name] foundation scholarship, [city] nursing scholarship foundation

org_types.why_target: Member or community-service scholarships; geographic limits.

org_types.org_type: Fire Department Auxiliary / Public Safety Association
org_types.why_target: Hyper-local residency awards; often unknown outside the town.
org_types.suggested_search_terms: [city] fire department scholarship, [city] police association scholarship

org_types.why_target: Women's equity branches fund local continuing-education awards.
